metrics.name: Data centers
metrics.source: PNNL IM3 Open Source Data Center Atlas (v2026.02.09; OSM-derived)
metrics.coverage: Mapped existing US facilities; join site geometry to the project's Census 2017 state and county equivalents
metrics.note: Count each existing physical data-center site once; a multi-building campus is one site. Exclude projected sites and overlapping campus/building records. Locations are OSM-derived and do not form a complete census.

metrics.name: Residential water tariff
metrics.source: Residential drinking-water utility tariffs · source to select
metrics.coverage: Utility service area; geographic coverage depends on selected tariff sources
metrics.note: Measure the volumetric drinking-water tariff, not a monthly bill. Exclude wastewater, fixed service charges and taxes; choose a reference consumption tier for block tariffs before comparing utilities. National coverage is incomplete.

metrics.name: Private companies valued at $1B+
metrics.source: Disclosed private financing valuations · source to select
metrics.coverage: US-headquartered private companies; state and city counts depend on source coverage
metrics.note: Count private US-headquartered companies with a source-backed post-money valuation of at least $1B from their latest disclosed priced round as of a stated date; exclude IPO and acquired companies. Undisclosed or stale valuations limit completeness. Valuation source and reuse rights remain to be selected.
